comments: Input facts: ego is the car responder; agent1 is the pedestrian initiator; the pedestrian remains within the trafficway, stationary or moving parallel without crossing. Chosen assumptions: The pedestrian initiates the conflict by walking ahead of ego in the same direction at a lower speed. Ego closes the gap and brakes. The schema crossing value denotes the walking behavior; its path is strictly longitudinal, with no attempt to cross the roadway. Distances are meters, speeds meters per second, reaction delay seconds, and brake/throttle controls dimensionless. The pedestrian conflict begins at time zero. These realizations create conflict opportunities; no collision outcome is imposed.
